reason: The array is buried, so the hand winch at the power pallet seems like a direct way to free it.
expectation: I expect the winch to pull the pallet or array out of the dust, though it may need preparation first.

alternatives.reason: The service tool might open the shipping frame, but the winch seems more directly connected to the buried pallet.

effect: The array is recovered, but its transport brackets need wider feet before it can stand on loose ground. The shipping frame can supply the material.
reaction: I’m curious how the salvaged frame will become stable supports.
reason: The result identifies the shipping frame as a source of material for feet, and this is the only numbered action available.
expectation: I expect the service tool to dismantle the frame into usable parts, though I don’t know exactly what it will produce.

effect: The frame has become metal stock that can be shaped around the array to make supports.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the shipping frame reused for a practical purpose.
reason: The stock is suited to making wider feet for the array, and this is the only numbered action available.
expectation: I expect the stock to be made into supports for the array, though it may need another step before it can power the cabin.

effect: The salvaged stock has made the array stand, so connecting power is the next apparent step.
reaction: It is satisfying to have the array upright.
reason: The power lead is the natural way to connect the standing array, and this is the only numbered action available.
expectation: I expect the lead to connect the array to the cabin, though another step may be needed to supply power.

effect: The power lead completed the solar power rack, and the cabin no longer relies on the battery alone. Both chapter goals are complete.
reaction: The fan settling into its ordinary sound makes the restored power feel tangible.

mostWorthwhile.text: Turning the shipping frame into wide feet was the most worthwhile passage: it connected material reuse to the practical problem of supporting the array on loose ground.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the power lead was straightforward and the only numbered option, so it offered little decision-making, though the outcome was reassuring.

surprise.text: I had not anticipated that the recovered array's narrow transport brackets would sink into the ground, or that the shipping frame could supply wider feet.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; each followed from the situation or the explanation given. After the first choice, however, there was only one numbered action at each step.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue. The practical reuse of the frame and the prospect of learning how the expedition develops make me curious about the next challenge.
